rationale: 11e 20.01 caps Strategic Reserves at half the army's starting points, and the practical cap is much lower: units in reserve score nothing and contest nothing while they wait. A 950-point reserve declaration lost a benchmark game outright (docs/AI_REVIEW_2026-07-11.md 2.4). This exam runs the formations phase and checks the AI's own declaration keeps reserves at or under 50% of army points.

assert.name: reserved points stay within the 11e 50% cap
